articles.title: Google DeepMind and A24 announce first-of-its-kind research partnership
articles.author: Google DeepMind
body: Today, Google DeepMind and A24 are announcing a first-of-its-kind partnership focused on research. The collaboration pairs a world-leading research lab with the industry’s most filmmaker-forward studio to help artists develop new workflows and techniques. This ensures the tools of the future are shaped by the creators who use them.

This partnership creates a deep research and development collaboration between A24 and Google DeepMind spanning multiple projects over time. By anchoring Google DeepMind's innovations directly within the creative process, A24 and its filmmakers can help shape new technology in service of their vision and expand their storytelling possibilities. This hands-on collaboration provides Google DeepMind with invaluable feedback and guidance from leading artists. In addition, Google has made an investment in A24.

Looking ahead, the partnership represents the beginning of a collaborative journey, one rooted in research and shared curiosity. While the initial focus is on bridging the gap between cutting-edge technology and next generation entertainment, the specific goals, technical outputs and creative milestones of this initiative will evolve over time. As A24 and Google DeepMind’s researchers work side-by-side to test, iterate and build, this partnership aims to expand what is possible in the future of entertainment.

articles.title: Trump thanks Fifa for spending USA striker's ban
articles.subtitle: Folarin Balogun is available to play for the United States in their World Cup last-16 tie against Belgium after his one-game ban is suspended by Fifa.
articles.author: BBC World
articles.summary: Folarin Balogun is available to play for the United States in their World Cup last-16 tie against Belgium after his one-game ban is suspended by Fifa.
body: Folarin Balogun has scored three goals for co-hosts United States at this World Cup
Folarin Balogun is available to play for the United States in their World Cup last-16 tie against Belgium after his one-game ban was suspended by Fifa.
The 25-year-old striker was shown a straight red card for a foul on Bosnia-Herzegovina defender Tarik Muharemovic as the co-hosts won their last-32 tie 2-0 .
Fifa said the automatic one-match ban would be suspended for a year. No reasoning behind the move was provided, beyond citing a rule which allows punishments to be suspended.
The Royal Belgian Football Association (RBFA) said it is "astonished" by Fifa's decision and is "investigating all potential options" in response.
"In line with article 27 of the Fifa disciplinary code, the implementation of the match suspension is suspended for a probationary period of one year," world governing body Fifa said in a statement.

"If Folarin Balogun commits another infringement of a similar nature and gravity during the probationary period, the suspension shall be revoked and the sanction enforced without prejudice to any additional sanction imposed for the new infringement."
US President Donald Trump thanked Fifa for "reversing a great injustice" in a post on Truth Social.
Trump, a friend of Gianni Infantino, wrote: "Thank you to Fifa for doing what was right, and reversing a great injustice! President DONALD J. TRUMP."
AFP and Reuters are reporting that Trump called Fifa president Gianni Infantino earlier this week to ask for the red card to be reviewed. The BBC has not yet confirmed these reports.
USA forward Christian Pulisic said the squad learned the one-game ban had been suspended on the bus to training on Sunday and said Balogun was "super happy".
Pulisic added: "Just a big smile on his face and all of ours. The foul wasn't what it was, it was harsh."

paragraphTranslations: 福拉林·巴洛贡在本届世界杯上为联合东道主美国队打进了三球。
在国际足联暂停了他的一场禁赛处罚后，福拉林·巴洛贡将可以代表美国队参加世界杯16强赛对阵比利时的比赛。
这位25岁的前锋因为在对阵波斯尼亚-黑塞哥维那的比赛中对后卫塔里克·穆哈雷莫维奇犯规而被直接出示红牌，当时作为联合东道主的美国队以2-0赢得了32强赛。
国际足联表示，自动的一场禁赛将被暂停一年。除了引用允许暂停处罚的规则外，没有提供此举背后的理由。
比利时皇家足球协会（RBFA）表示，对国际足联的决定感到“震惊”，并正在“调查所有可能的选项”以作回应。
“根据国际足联纪律守则第27条，比赛暂停的实施被暂停一年试用期，”世界管理机构国际足联在声明中说。
“如果在试用期间，福拉林·巴洛贡再次犯下性质和严重性类似的违规行为，将撤销暂停，并且执行处罚，而不妨碍对新的违规行为施加的任何额外处罚。”
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在Truth Social上的一篇帖子中感谢国际足联“纠正了一个巨大的不公”。
特朗普，吉安尼·因凡蒂诺的朋友，写道：“感谢国际足联做了正确的事，纠正了一个巨大的不公！总统唐纳德·J·特朗普。”
法新社和路透社报道说，特朗普本周早些时候打电话给国际足联主席吉安尼·因凡蒂诺，要求复审红牌。BBC尚未证实这些报道。
美国队前锋克里斯蒂安·普利西奇表示，球队在周日前往训练的巴士上得知一场禁赛被暂停，他说巴洛贡“非常高兴”。
普利西奇补充说：“他脸上挂着大大的笑容，我们也是。那次犯规并不是那样的，判罚过于严厉了。”
